Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target dictionary with component sequences to retrieve protein accessions and sequences. Filter by target type equal to SINGLE PROTEIN. Return target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, and protein_sequence.
